title: From Pages to Plates: Kura Sushi USA Partners with Nintendo’s Yoshi and the Mysterious Book Game

# From Pages to Plates: Kura Sushi USA Partners with Nintendo’s Yoshi and the Mysterious Book Game


Crack the code to deliciousness with an all-new immersive dining experience at Kura Revolving Sushi Bar on November 1


October 29, 2026


The fun discoveries continue at Kura Revolving Sushi Bar, as **Yoshi, Mr. E,** and **Smiley Flowers** leap from the pages of the storybook and into the iconic Bikkura Pon prize machine![Kura Sushi USA, Inc.](https://kurasushi.com/) , the nation's largest brand of revolving sushi restaurants, today announced its partnership with **[Nintendo of America](https://www.nintendo.com/us/)** to bridge the world of the[Yoshi and the Mysterious](https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/yoshi-and-the-mysterious-book-switch-2/) Book game on the[Nintendo Switch 2](https://www.nintendo.com/us/gaming-systems/switch-2/features/) system with Kura Sushi’s playful dining experience.


Starting Nov. 1, Yoshi superfans can embark on a delicious journey with limited-time menu items, exclusive prizes, and special giveaways inspired by Yoshi™ and the Mysterious Book.


**A Tasty Culinary Adventure of Discovery:**


Embark on a delicious journey of exploration and discovery with a menu inspired by the kind, heroic green friend.


- **“Ground Pound” Crunch Roll:** Shrimp tempura, shrimp mayo and avocado wrapped in seaweed and Kura specialty rice, topped with sesame seeds, red crunchy and matcha cream sauce drizzle.
- **Shrimp Avocado “Tail Flick” Nigiri:** Shrimp and avocado topped with yuzu cream sauce drizzle and sliced red onion, layered over Kura specialty rice.
- **“Gobble” Up Matcha Parfait:** New York cheesecake, crunchy and matcha ice cream topped with frozen strawberry and matcha sauce drizzle.


**Charming Capsule Prize Encounters:**


Uncover all the capsule prize treasures with **eight collectible acrylic carabiners, magnet bookmark 2-piece sets, and a microfiber cloth.** Kura Revolving Sushi Bar guests will receive a single randomized Yoshi and the Mysterious Book x Kura Sushi Bikkura Pon capsule prize after consuming sushi plates—15, 25, then every 15 plates thereafter.


**Exclusive Kura Sushi Rewards Member Offer:**


Kura Sushi Rewards members will have more reasons to dine in during this Yoshi™ and the Mysterious Book collaboration with two exclusive giveaways:


- **November 4:** Receive a two-piece plate set with $85 minimum in-restaurant order, while supplies last.*
- **November 18:** Receive a blanket with $85 minimum in-restaurant order, while supplies last.*


“This collaboration is a true celebration of playfulness and discovery, and we are absolutely thrilled to partner with Nintendo of America to bring the vibrant world of the Yoshi and the Mysterious Book game to our revolving sushi bars," said Sally Kurosaki, Senior Promotions & Licensing Manager at Kura Sushi USA, Inc.


Kura Sushi’s proprietary Bikkura Pon prize platform, an integral part of the brand’s innovative dining experience, is powered by plate count and adds an element of surprise and excitement to every visit. With more than 600 million plates served in the U.S., the program remains a fan favorite.


For more information about the Yoshi and the Mysterious Book x Kura Sushi Bikkura Pon collaboration visit[kurasushi.com](https://kurasushi.com/) , and fans can follow along on Kura Sushi’s[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/kurasushi_usa/) and enter two whimsical giveaways on Nov. 19 and Nov. 30, rules apply.


**Kura Sushi Rewards members only. Limit 1 unit per member. Limited time offer, no substitutions. Availability may differ by location and is not guaranteed. Additional charges, terms, and exclusions may apply.*


*Nintendo is not a sponsor, co-sponsor or administrator of this promotion.*


**About Kura Sushi USA, Inc.**


Kura Sushi USA, Inc. is the nation’s largest brand of revolving sushi restaurants that serves authentic Japanese cuisine and delivers a joyful dining experience with more than 90 locations in 25 states and Washington D.C. Utilizing advanced innovation to enhance service speed and accuracy, guests have a wide variety of more than 100 menu items at their fingertips via conveyor belt service inclusive of sushi, sashimi, tempura, noodles, desserts, and more, made with high-quality ingredients free of artificial colorings, preservatives, seasonings and sweeteners. Kura Sushi USA, Inc. was established in 2008 as a subsidiary of Kura Sushi, Inc., a Japan-based revolving sushi chain with more than 600 restaurants internationally and 45 years of brand history. For more information about Kura Sushi USA, visit[kurasushi.com](https://kurasushi.com/) , follow Kura Sushi USA on[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/kurasushiusa) ,[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/kurasushi_usa/) ,[TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@kurasushiusa) &[X](https://x.com/kurasushi_usa) , and download the[Kura Sushi Rewards app](https://kurasushi.com/rewards) to make a reservation and roll into delicious loyalty perks.
